brief:
Israel continues to carry out airstrikes in Gaza, the Quincy Institute reported. The operations represent a continuation of military action in the densely populated territory, where civilian infrastructure and residential areas have been subject to strikes in recent months.

The scope and frequency of the current airstrikes remain unclear from available reporting. No immediate details were available regarding specific targets, military objectives, or the scale of damage and casualties from the operations. The strikes underscore the persistent military pressure Israel maintains in Gaza amid broader regional tensions.
title: Israel carries out ongoing airstrikes in Gaza
